referenceFunction.generalComment: The shares are based on the real total energy that will be obtained by MOX fuels in current Swiss PWRs over their entire lifetime. This module belongs to the chain with enrichment from centrifuge only. Hence, the indication of data validity inputted in "TimePeriod" only says that the shares represent the knowledge available today of the fuel management for the Swiss PWRs.; UUID: 78c59748-2056-30cf-bc41-efa7d49b4e7c
